pages.title: Two Parents
pages.text: Load two $(l)non rooster$() chicken items plus $(l)seeds$(). The Breeder consumes the seeds and attempts to produce offspring according to the breeding table.$(br2)A successful attempt can yield either parent breed or, with luck, the higher tier child they unlock together.

pages.title: Patience
pages.text: Child chance falls as tier rises. For the rarest breeds, automate the Breeder and let it run rather than watching it.$(br2)Offspring inherit averaged and slightly randomised parent stats, so breeding is also how you push growth, gain and strength toward 10.
